name: Five whys
when: the stated problem is probably not the real one
prompt: Descend from symptom to cause. Keep asking why.
readback: The bottom rung is a working hypothesis, not gospel. Ask whether it is testable this week.

claims.claim: Iteratively asking "why?" from a symptom reaches a cause which, when addressed, prevents recurrence more reliably than unstructured problem discussion.

grounding.helps: when the stated problem is probably a symptom; descending by "why" is manufacturing craft with no controlled test, so treat the bottom rung as a hypothesis to test this week
grounding.backfires: when the chain stops at an arbitrary depth, settles on one cause for a problem with several, or ends by blaming a person; in hospital root-cause work, repeated analyses mostly produced weak fixes and the same events recurred
